description.value: Zeballos Library is a branch of the Vancouver Island Regional Library system serving this small, remote community at the end of a logging road on northern Vancouver Island. For touring cyclists making the long journey to Zeballos, it stands as one of the few public facilities in a community otherwise defined by its wilderness setting and limited services. As a public library, it offers a quiet indoor space in an area where such amenities are rare.
